prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: standalone high resolution illustrative construction photograph for Tomoroga Construct website.
Primary request: Create one clean square photograph approximately 1200 by 1200 pixels matching ONLY the site visit photograph in the middle right of the supplied full website composition. Two adult construction professionals viewed from behind in the lower foreground, wearing white hardhats, inspecting a large paper building plan between them. Left professional wears a bright yellow-green safety vest with reflective bands over a dark jacket. Right professional wears a plain dark jacket and points at the plan. Behind them, unfinished concrete columns and floor slabs, dark steel roof members, gravel ground, distant construction equipment and clear pale blue sky.
Input image: supplied full website design is only a reference for the site visit photograph's subject, framing, materials and natural light. Extract its photographic concept and regenerate a new standalone image.
Composition: square frame; people occupy lower two thirds; upward receding unfinished concrete structure fills the background; backs and helmets visible, plans central bottom. Natural believable proportions and crisp material detail.
Style/medium: real editorial construction photography in natural daylight, realistic skin, clothing and concrete textures, authentic colours.
Constraints: exactly one standalone photograph. All clothing and helmets must be unbranded and blank. No readable text on the plan, no logos, no company names, no watermarks, no page layout, no captions, no UI, no letters, numbers, annotations or hotspot circles. Illustrative concept, not an actual company project.
